company_name: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. Common Shares
title: Metalla Publishes 2026 Asset Handbook And Annual Letter To Shareholders
summary: Vancouver, British Columbia: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. (“Metalla” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: MTA) (TSXV: MTA) is pleased to announce the release of its 2026 Asset Handbook outlining the Company’s high-quality gold, silver, and copper production, development, and exploration assets, as well as Mineral Reserve and Mineral Resource data. Included in the Asset Handbook is the annual letter to shareholders. The Asset Handbook is available on the Company’s website at www.metallaroyalty.com.
